# Now 2.13.80
- Podcast transcripts now keep pace with the voice. Apple Podcasts only reports its playback position to the system occasionally, so the position available to Now trails the audio and the transcript trailed with it. Measured against Apple's own transcript view, its highlighted line sat between four and six seconds ahead of the position shown on the same screen. The transcript is now brought forward to compensate, with a Sync control under Lyrics in Settings to fine tune it, since the gap varies by episode and with inserted advertising.

# Now 2.13.79
- Podcast transcripts now keep up with the speaker. A spoken sentence is far longer than a sung line, so showing one sentence at a time meant the overlay displayed as much as would fit and then sat there, sometimes for twenty seconds, until the whole sentence finished. Long sentences are now broken into shorter lines at natural pauses, each starting exactly when its first word is spoken, so the text advances every couple of seconds and stays with the voice.

# Now 2.13.78
- Podcast transcripts should now actually appear. The episode identifier that locates the transcript was being lost one step before it was used: the track is copied just before the lyrics are looked up, and that copy was not carrying the identifier across. Added a test covering the whole path from the player to the file, since this is the second way the identifier has gone missing.
